prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures the chaotic calm of a theatre backstage. On the left stands a tall woman in a velvet gown, her posture rigid as she holds a feathered fan. Next to her, a small boy in striped pajamas sits on a wooden crate, his legs dangling freely while he looks up at the woman. In the center, an old man with a bushy beard leans against a stack of scenery flats, wiping sweat from his brow with a rag. To his right, a black cat perches atop a lighting rig, its tail twitching slightly as it watches the activity below. Near the right edge, a young dancer in a tutu points toward a broken prop sword lying on the floor. Beside the dancer, a stagehand in blue overalls kneels to pick up the sword, his back turned to the viewer. There is no visible audience or stage lights illuminating the performance area. The woman in the velvet gown interacts with the boy by offering him a piece of candy from her purse. The stagehand in blue overalls hands the repaired prop sword to the young dancer in the tutu. The black cat remains aloof, observing the exchange from its high vantage point. The old man with the bushy beard continues to rest, seemingly unaware of the minor drama unfolding nearby. The wooden crate shows signs of wear, with chipped paint revealing the grain beneath. The feathered fan casts a soft shadow on the woman's dress. The scenery flats are stacked haphazardly, suggesting a recent move. The rag in the old man's hand is stained with grease. The striped pajamas of the boy are slightly oversized. The tutu of the dancer is frayed at the edges. The blue overalls of the stagehand are dusty from work.
